## Overview

This project focuses on a precise embedded signal chain, from analog input
sampling through signal processing and waveform generation.

## Implementation

- Added 16-bit ADC capture and calibration.
- Implemented DAC output for waveform generation.
- Applied digital filtering to improve measurement stability.

## Outcome

The work provides a structured path to low-noise measurements and repeatable
analog validation. Add measured results, hardware details, and test conditions
here as the project documentation develops.
